visual.general_description: Single-series line graph of serial CA-125 values with a dashed vertical line separating the induction and maintenance phases.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background line graph titled CA-125 (U/mL) with ten square-marked points and printed values falling from 120.0 to a low of 19.6 and ending at 25.0, ten rotated date labels on the x-axis, and a dashed vertical line with printed phase labels for TC plus tislelizumab and tislelizumab maintenance.

panels.general_description: Single-series black line graph of CA-125 in U/mL over ten printed dates with a dashed vertical line separating a TC plus tislelizumab segment from a tislelizumab maintenance segment.
panels.detailed_description: White background with the bold title CA-125 (U/mL). The y-axis runs from 0.0 to 140.0 in steps of 20.0 with light gray horizontal gridlines. A thick black line with square markers connects ten points, each with a printed value above it: 120.0, 114.0, 71.0, 39.3, 32.5, 27.1, 27.4, 19.6, 23.6 and 25.0. The rotated x-axis labels read 2024.05.22, 2024.06.17, 2024.07.10, 2024.07.31, 2024.08.24, 2024.09.23, 2024.10.21, 2024.11.11, 2024.12.11 and 2025.01.06. The line falls steeply from 120.0 to 39.3 over the first four points, flattens between about 32.5 and 27.4, reaches a low of 19.6 at 2024.11.11 and rises slightly to 23.6 and 25.0. A dashed vertical line lies between 2024.11.11 and 2024.12.11. Text to its left reads “TC + tislelizumab”(6 cycles) and text to its right reads “tislelizumab” maintenance.
